title: Admin token ledger + rotation playbook: per-scope keys, naming, expiry, and audit hooks
creator: Ryan Chen
description: Create an operational playbook and implementation for admin API tokens that covers per-scope token issuance, deterministic naming conventions, automatic expiry and rotation, and audit-log hooks. This ticket consolidates prior token governance work into an actionable implementation with runbook steps, schema for a token ledger, and deployment plan compatible with RBAC v2 and our audit pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: Token issuance supports scope-limited tokens (read-only, read-write, admin) per-service and per-user/service-account
Token metadata persisted in a searchable ledger (created_by, name, scopes, expiry, rotation_history) visible in Console for owners
Automatic rotation policy enforces expiry and provides grace windows; expired tokens are unusable after grace period
Naming convention enforced at issuance and surfaced in audit logs (env-service-user-description-timestamp)
Audit logging emits structured events for create/rotate/revoke operations and includes pre/post policy evaluation results
Backward-compatible API for existing hosted customers; migration doc and opt-in for immediate rotations
Automated smoke tests and a canary rollout with telemetry to detect auth failures before full release
implementation_steps: Design token ledger schema and storage backend (append-only, TTL for expired records)
Define deterministic naming rules and client/server validation rules
Add per-scope issuance flow to Admin API and Console UI with clear UX for selecting scopes and expiry
Implement rotation workflow: rotate endpoint, rotation job, grace-window logic, and alerting hooks
Wire structured audit events into our existing audit pipeline and ensure retention policies
Migrate existing long-lived keys: opt-in migration path + bulk rotation CLI for org admins
Add RBAC v2 policy checks at token issuance and revocation paths
Create e2e tests, integration tests, and add telemetry dashboards for token lifecycle metrics
Prepare rollout plan: alpha customers -> internal -> canary -> global; include fallback to legacy tokens where needed
risks_and_tradeoffs: Persisting a ledger increases storage/operational costs — tradeoff between retention window and SRE burden
Stricter naming and expiry rules may break automation for a subset of customers — provide migration utilities and a grace flag
Real-time enforcement vs eventual consistency for rotation: strong consistency reduces risk but increases latency on issuance
Audit volume increase could inflate storage and SIEM ingestion costs; need sampling and compression strategy
comments: 2026-03-01 - Ryan Chen: Ticket created after security blitz. Consolidates prior PRs and design docs. Goal: ship minimum secure defaults for tokens by 2026-04.
2026-03-03 - Maya Patel: Initial spike complete. Proposed ledger schema in Confluence link. Prefers append-only ledger with per-record JSON and an indexed search layer.
2026-03-04 - Security Review (Olivia Gupta): Raised policy: rotation grace window must be configurable per-org; default 7 days. Also requested threat model for token enumeration attacks.

2026-03-06 - Engineering lead (Dmitri Novak): Decided to implement server-side name validation and provide SDK helpers for deterministic names. Agreed to support legacy token types behind feature flag for 4 weeks post-launch.
2026-03-07 - UX (Ava Martinez): Mockups for console token creation ready. Added a warning UX for wide-scoped tokens and suggested default expiry of 90 days for admin tokens.
2026-03-08 - Maya Patel: Began implementation. Added token_ledger service skeleton, started DB migration script. Opened GitHub PR: see links.
2026-03-09 - QA (Ellen Park): Requesting acceptance tests for rotation sequence: issue -> rotate -> old token invalid -> new token valid -> audit event emitted.

2026-03-10 - Incident learning: customer reported a leaked long-lived key in a sandbox org. We used interim revocation API to rotate; reinforced need for bulk rotation CLI and better discovery in Console.

2026-03-11 - Maya Patel: Addressed security feedback: added rate-limit on issuance endpoints to mitigate enumeration and added event signature to audit logs for tamper-resistance. PR updated for review.
testing_plan: Unit tests for ledger schema and rotation job logic
Integration tests for Admin API issuance/rotation/revoke flows
Simulated canary that rotates tokens in a test org and validates telemetry
Chaos test: revoke tokens during active sessions to ensure graceful failures are handled
Performance test: issuance QPS under burst load with rate limiting enabled
additional_notes: Coordinate with Console and Observability teams for dashboard widgets (token counts by scope, rotation latency, failed-auth spikes). Schedule a postmortem if migration causes >0.1% auth error increase during rollout.
